APPROVE
The extraction moves the per-method loop unchanged into a lazily yielded helper and pulls out the decision ternary; swapping the order of `classGuard ||` is harmless because both sides have no side effects, which should bring `Nest` well under 15. One caveat: I couldn't open the file, so the `List<Decorator>` parameter type and the remaining complexity of `Nest` are inferred from the diff, not checked by building.
